clues.definition: Schwas are unstressed mid-central vowel sounds, commonly represented by the symbol /ə/ in the International Phonetic Alphabet.
clues.explanation: SCHWAS fits because the plural clue asks for more than one unstressed vowel sound. A schwa is the reduced vowel heard in many unstressed English syllables, and its six-letter plural matches the entry.
clues.signal: The plural noun “sounds” requires a plural answer, while “unstressed vowel” points to a specific phonetic term.
clues.hint: Use the six-letter plural term for reduced mid-central vowel sounds often written with /ə/.
